summary: The WI contains none of the press-shop process: no shearing, blanking, piercing, forming, projection welding, plating, storage or packing, and no single golden setting or dimension. Instead it describes a generic assembly/spot-welding job, puts the supplier code S-06220 in the machine and tooling fields, leaves the Drawing No. blank and gives revision 01 instead of 00.
